newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-BERGER'S NOT LEAVING, SAY BENETTON.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-BERGER'S NOT LEAVING, SAY BENETTON.

text.p: Formula One racing team Benetton on Saturday denied reports that Austrian driver Gerhard Berger might quit the team or give up grand prix racing altogether.
In an interview with Austrian radio ORF, Berger, who has missed the last two races because of a sinus infection, said: "Today I am not able to say if I will compete in Formula One next year.
"I will make a decision about my future in August."

But Benetton said in a statement: "Gerhard simply said that it's too early to talk about his plans for next year. He spoke highly of his current team, Benetton Formula, and said he had no intention of quitting the team."
The Austrian driver also said in the interview that he did not know if he would be physically fit to take part in the British Grand Prix next weekend.
Berger last seriously considered retirement after the deaths of compatriot Roland Ratzenberger and Brazilian three-time world champion Ayrton Senna at the 1994 San Marino Grand Prix.
